constraints: client-core is platform-neutral, no-dependency, forbid(unsafe_code); it already has pure state/rules modules for quest, mail compose/parcel, equipment pending, NPC purchase attempts, motion and reconciliation, but no auth/login registration or SafeKey module.
client-bevy already depends on client-core, so native_shell can delegate without a new dependency; NativeShellModel and form lifecycle currently live in client-bevy/native_shell.rs.

platform-web depends on client-core and uses serde/serde_json/wasm-bindgen; current wasm-bindgen API has global client_core_abi_version=1 plus optional per-feature ABI exports for independent capabilities.

Web runtime lazily imports immutable `/client-core/<manifest.version>/mir2_platform_web.js`, initializes the associated WASM once, checks global ABI then offers sync calls after load (client-core-runtime.ts:358-429; Page useEffect loads at 2514).

Do not increase byte budget to make new logic fit without explicit review.

pageOwner.authOwner: This physical connection guard is available for pre-auth UI. Existing `currentSocialReplyOwner` requires a game/active player world, so do not reuse it for Login/Register/ChangePassword.
pageOwner.newLease: For any new pre-auth dialog/request, bind one pending operation to `{socket identity, connectionGeneration, auth surface/form epoch, operation kind}`; invalidate on socket close/replacement or dialog close/remount; because server packets carry no request ID, keep at most one outstanding instance per response kind per socket and only project a response into matching current UI. Do not reuse `activeReconnectAuthRef` for new registration/change-password secrets.
pageOwner.socket: Page connectGateway increments equipmentConnectionGenerationRef and stores the socket (page.tsx:6830-6858); listeners capture that physical socket plus generation (6916-6920); central handleGatewayEvent rejects non-current generation or socket (11252-11254).

existingWeb.resultProjection: Page handles NewAccount packet result (page.tsx:11450-11457), but does not hold a native-equivalent pending form lease or full registration draft. It reports all non-8 result codes as disabled. Password-change result is log-only and has a success-code mismatch; banned response omits expiry.

summary: The existing Gateway supports full NewAccount and ChangePassword commands and returns response packets under authentication rate limits. Shared source work should live in dependency-free client-core, be reused by client-bevy NativeShell and exposed to Web only through platform-web/WASM. The current Web shell is incomplete for full registration, password change and SafeKey; Core has no auth module. Main constraints are preserving the Gateway auth/rate-limit authority, generation-bound pre-auth request handling, preserving Native pending/result semantics, and the tight current WASM byte budget. Unknowns remain explicit.
